businesses.business: hospice care and plumbing/drain cleaning services

offering_description.value: Provides hospice and palliative care to terminally ill patients through VITAS Healthcare, mainly in patients' homes. Also provides plumbing, drain cleaning and water restoration services to residential and commercial customers through Roto-Rooter, using company-owned branches and franchises.

primary_services.value: hospice and palliative care; plumbing repair; drain cleaning; water damage restoration

customer_segment.value: B2C: terminally ill patients and families, homeowners needing plumbing and drain services; B2B: commercial property owners and businesses needing plumbing and drain services, franchisees; B2G: Medicare and Medicaid programs as payers for hospice care

end_markets.value: healthcare; hospice care; residential plumbing services; commercial facilities maintenance

revenue_model.value: healthcare reimbursement: Medicare and Medicaid per-diem hospice payments, plus private insurers; service fees: plumbing, drain cleaning and restoration jobs paid by customers; licensing or royalties: franchise royalties from Roto-Rooter franchisees
revenue_model.category: healthcare reimbursement; service fees; licensing or royalties

value_chain_position.value: service provider: delivers hospice care using clinical staff, paid mainly by government programs; service provider: performs plumbing and drain services using company technicians and franchisees for homes and businesses

geography_served.value: US national: Hospice in about 14 states and DC, Roto-Rooter across the US and parts of Canada via franchises

specialization.value: diversified: hospice care and plumbing/drain services, two unrelated businesses with different customers

distribution_channels.value: own locations: VITAS hospice programs and inpatient units, company-owned Roto-Rooter branches; direct sales: phone and web booking of plumbing services, physician and hospital referrals for hospice; partners / resellers: independent Roto-Rooter franchisees
distribution_channels.category: own locations; direct sales; partners / resellers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: hospice regulated by CMS Medicare/Medicaid conditions and state licensure, plumbing licensing and environmental rules

divestiture_lines: P2.2: The Company’s day to day operating businesses are managed on a decentralized basis. There are few integrated business functions between the operating units and Chemed (such as sales, marketing or purchasing). Since its inception, the Company has engaged in twelve significant acquisitions or divestitures of diverse business units.
